1: #!/bin/bash
2: 
3: set -euo pipefail
4: 
5: # We use the shaded protobuf JAR from the protobuf-shaded module.
6: # I could not figure out how to use a protoc Maven plugin to use the shaded module,
7: # so I ran this command to generate the sources manually.
8: 
9: TARGET_DIR=$1
10: PROTO_DIR=src/main/protobuf
11: PROTOBUF_VERSION_STRING=$2
12: PROTOBUF_VERSION="${PROTOBUF_VERSION_STRING//_/.}"
13: 
14: echo "Generating protobuf sources for version $PROTOBUF_VERSION in $TARGET_DIR"
15: 
16: rm -rf "$TARGET_DIR"
17: mkdir -p "$TARGET_DIR"
18: rm -rf $PROTO_DIR || true
19: mkdir -p $PROTO_DIR
20: 
21: OLD_PACKAGE=$(sed -nE 's/import (io.prometheus.metrics.expositionformats.generated.*).Metrics;/\1/p' src/main/java/io/prometheus/metrics/expositionformats/internal/PrometheusProtobufWriterImpl.java)
22: PACKAGE="io.prometheus.metrics.expositionformats.generated.com_google_protobuf_${PROTOBUF_VERSION_STRING}"
23: 
24: if [[ $OLD_PACKAGE != "$PACKAGE" ]]; then
25: 	echo "Replacing package $OLD_PACKAGE with $PACKAGE in all java files"
26: 	find .. -type f -name "*.java" -exec sed -i "s/$OLD_PACKAGE/$PACKAGE/g" {} +
27: fi
28: 
29: curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prometheus/client_model/master/io/prometheus/client/metrics.proto -o $PROTO_DIR/metrics.proto
30: 
31: sed -i "s/java_package = \"io.prometheus.client\"/java_package = \"$PACKAGE\"/" $PROTO_DIR/metrics.proto
32: protoc --java_out "$TARGET_DIR" $PROTO_DIR/metrics.proto
33: sed -i '1 i\//CHECKSTYLE:OFF: checkstyle' "$(find src/main/generated/io -type f)"
34: sed -i -e $'$a\\\n//CHECKSTYLE:ON: checkstyle' "$(find src/main/generated/io -type f)"
